en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow-covered street lined with wooden houses in a small town. Heavy snow blankets the road, fences, roofs, and bare tree branches in the foreground. In the background stands a church-like building with a tower beside a frozen river or lake. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner, and the photographer credit is in the lower right corner.
